frozen_native_model.checkpoint: float4[nbuckets*256] (color.rgb + T) written in forward blend_cu, read in backward
frozen_native_model.state_recovery: replay 32-splat compositing recurrence within each bucket from checkpoint

cost_model_per_valid_visit.scan_compose_note: Blelloch work-efficient inclusive prefix scan: 2 composes/visit * 7 flop (A1+B1*A2=3mul+3add, B1*B2=1mul)
cost_model_per_valid_visit.scan_note: transform M_k=(A_k=a_k*c_k, B_k=1-a_k) pre-built in forward (alpha already computed there); backward scan has 0 exp; gradient needs gaussian=alpha/opacity (1 div) — counted in gradient, not state-recovery

real_trace_inputs.source: BARS0_TILE_TRACE.json + APBC0_REACHABILITY_TRACE.json (real FasterGSFused fused-backward tiles, 1920x1080, seed42, iter25000)

reduction_formula: (exp_cost + native_flop - scan_flop) / (exp_cost + native_flop); native_flop=11 (incl min), scan_flop=17 (compose14+cafter3, exp eliminated)

structural_findings.scene_independence: reduction ratio is identical across room/garden/bicycle (per-visit cost ratio); scene mix does not change the gate outcome
structural_findings.scan_compose_exceeds_replay: Blelloch compose (14 flop/visit) > native replay recurrence (10-11 flop/visit); the general associative compose is strictly more arithmetic than the fixed-32-bucket recurrence
structural_findings.only_saving_is_exp: the sole state-recovery saving is eliminating the backward expf recomputation (native recomputes expf per visit; scan reuses forward-stored alpha)
structural_findings.memory: scan transform storage (V*4 floats) ~= native checkpoint storage (nbuckets*256*4 floats) since V ~= nbuckets*256; no meaningful memory reduction
structural_findings.sync_depth: native replay depth=32 (sequential within bucket via shfl_up); scan depth=log2(splats/pixel)~8; scan better on depth but depth is not throughput-bound on A100

verdict_rationale: Gate 4 requires >=20% state-recovery work reduction in >=2/3 scenes. The model predicts a scene-independent reduction of (exp-6)/(exp+8), which crosses 20% only when precise expf costs >=~9.5 FMA-equiv. Precise expf on A100 is estimated 8-16 FMA-equiv (multi-instruction: range-reduction + polynomial + 1 SFU op), placing the reduction at 12-37% — straddling the threshold. At fast-exp (__expf~4) the scan is 13% WORSE. Because the reduction is not robustly >=20% across the realistic expf cost range and P0 forbids measuring the actual expf cost (no CUDA profiling), Gate 4 is not confidently passed. The associative scan trades cheap structured replay recurrence for more expensive general compose; it does not reduce state-recovery work.
